extensionName.description: Name of the extension, shown in the add-ons manager.

extensionDescription.message: Track time on projects and tasks in their own Thunderbird tab.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension, shown in the add-ons manager.

spaceTitle.description: Tooltip of the spaces toolbar button.

commandToggleTimer.message: Start the last task or stop the running timer
commandToggleTimer.description: Keyboard shortcut description in the add-on shortcut settings.

trackerPlaceholder.message: Projects, tasks and time entries will appear here.
trackerPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the tracker tab before the real UI exists.

trackerProjectsLabel.description: Heading of the project list in the tracker tab.

trackerSummary.description: Data summary in the tracker tab.

trackerEmpty.description: Shown in the tracker tab when there is no data.

popupPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the toolbar popup.

trackerLoadError.message: Could not load your data. Try reopening this tab.
trackerLoadError.description: Shown in the tracker tab when the background does not answer.

tableColumnPicker.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the column picker button in table headers (same as Thunderbird).

tableResizeColumn.description: Accessible name of a column resize handle.

notificationClose.description: Accessible name of the close button on a notification bar.

sidebarNewTask.description: Primary button at the top of the project pane.

sidebarAddEntry.description: Icon button next to New Task.

sidebarMore.description: Kebab button in the project pane header.

sidebarResize.description: Accessible name of the splitter between the project pane and the task list.

modeViews.description: Section heading in the project pane (like Thunderbird folder modes).

modeProjects.description: Section heading in the project pane.

modeOptions.description: Accessible name of the kebab button of a project pane section.

viewToday.description: Built-in view of tasks tracked today.

viewThisWeek.description: Built-in view of tasks tracked this week.

projectArchive.description: Collapsed group of archived projects at the bottom of the project tree.

listSummary.description: Muted summary next to the project name above the task list.

listQuickFilter.description: Toggle button that shows the quick filter bar (same name as Thunderbird).

listDisplayOptions.description: Icon button above the task list (same name as Thunderbird).

filterOpen.description: Quick filter toggle: only open tasks.

filterStarred.description: Quick filter toggle: only starred tasks.

filterBillable.description: Quick filter toggle: only billable tasks.

filterTags.description: Quick filter toggle: filter by tags.

filterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the quick filter text field.

filterLabel.description: Accessible name of the quick filter text field.

filterShortcut.description: Shortcut hint shown inside the quick filter field.

tasksLabel.description: Accessible name of the task table.

columnWeek.description: Task table column: time this week.

columnLastTracked.description: Task table column: when time was last tracked.

lastTrackedRunning.description: Last tracked cell of the running task.

lastTrackedNever.description: Last tracked cell of a task without time entries.

doneShow.description: Link-style button in the task list footer that shows done tasks.

taskRunning.description: Accessible label of the timer icon in the running task row.
